title: Background agent report
description: What a background agent writes when it finishes. Read this, not the agent's prose summary: a summary can smooth over a failure, a field cannot.

ticket.description: Issue URL or number this resolves.

status.description: pass: everything asked for ran and succeeded. fail: it ran and something failed - that is a result, not a problem. blocked: it could not be run at all. `blocked` exists so an agent never has to choose between inventing a way to make something run and reporting nothing; an agent with only pass/fail will manufacture a pass.

checks.description: One entry per command in the brief, in order, including ones that never ran.

command.description: Verbatim, exactly as given in the brief.

failures.description: Exact test names or error identifiers. Never a paraphrase.

output_excerpt.description: The lines that decide the result, copied verbatim.

blockers.description: Anything that stopped a command running. Report it; do not route around it.

workaround_considered.description: If a way around it occurred to you, name it here instead of doing it. This field is where a substituted dependency or a skipped suite belongs.

findings.description: Anything true and load-bearing that the brief did not ask about - a suite that skipped silently, a version that did not match, a warning nobody asked for.

negative_proof.description: For a bug fix: evidence each new test fails without the change. Upstream requires this and it matters most when the tests were model-written.
